intro.title: Backlog spring cleaning.
intro.sub: 需求池大扫除，附赠后悔药。

outro.title: From idea to merged PR, with the agents you already use.
outro.sub: 把想法交给 Agent，一路跟到合并 · tomrade.com

captions.en: Nine tickets. Two of them are twins.
captions.zh: 九张工单，其中两张是双胞胎。

captions.en: It reads every ticket first. Unlike some of us.
captions.zh: 它先把每张单都读一遍。比某些人强。
它出方案，你拍板。老板体验，拉满。

captions.en: Nothing runs until you say so.
captions.zh: 你不点头，它一个字都不改。

captions.en: Twins merged. The monster ticket, split four ways.
captions.zh: 双胞胎合体，巨无霸一拆四。

captions.en: Regret it? Revert the whole run.
captions.zh: 后悔了？整次运行，一键撤回。
captions.note: Undo covers what Tomrade wrote. Your code stays put.
